record.paper_title: Solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs
record.original_question: Characterize the family of join graphs K_r + G for which ψ_q(K_r + G) = 1, where K_r is the complete graph on r vertices and K_r + G denotes the join obtained by adding all edges between K_r and G.

evidence.quote: 1. Characterize the family of graphs Kr + G for which ψq(Kr + G) = 1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G=(V,E) be a finite simple graph. For a vertex v∈V, let N[v]=N(v)∪{v} denote its closed neighborhood. A proper or improper partition π={V_1,…,V_k} of V into nonempty color classes is called a quorum coloring of G if, for every vertex v∈V, at least half of the vertices of N[v] lie in the same class of π as v; that is, |N[v]∩V_i|≥|N[v]|/2, where V_i is the class containing v. The quorum coloring number ψ_q(G) is the maximum number of color classes in any quorum coloring of G.

For positive integers r and a graph H, let K_r+H denote the join of the complete graph K_r and H, i.e., the graph obtained from the disjoint union of K_r and H by adding every edge between a vertex of K_r and a vertex of H.

Problem: Characterize all pairs (r,G) with r≥1 and G a finite simple graph such that ψ_q(K_r+G)=1.
artifact.status_search_result: The characterization of graphs with quorum coloring number equal to 1 (including the join family K_r+G) appears to remain open. Related work shows that no polynomial-time/"good" characterization is expected unless P = NP ∩ co-NP, and only partial families (such as odd complete graphs and certain joins of two complete graphs) are known. No published complete characterization of K_r+G with ψ_q=1 was located.

status_evidence.title: Solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Article addressing open problems on quorum colorings; the K_r+G characterization is listed as a remaining open problem.
status_evidence.claim: The characterization problem for K_r+G with ψ_q=1 is posed as open.

status_evidence.title: On some open problems concerning quorum colorings of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses open problems on quorum colorings, noting partial families with ψ_q=1 and complexity barriers to a full characterization.
status_evidence.claim: A general characterization of graphs with ψ_q=1 is not known and likely hard.
